Name: Husky's Small Functional Farmhouse
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
Does the game require you to have a farmhouse but you hate decorating and just put the bed by the door? Then this is the farmhouse for you!

Featuring:
• Zero unnecessary space
• Zero House renovations from Robin outside of getting rid of the crib
• Minimal room to get around
• A kitchen so small that if you get married, some days your spouse will stand in your way and make you mad while trying to get to the cellar!

This map replaces the default farmhouse and is for you minimalists who don't care how much room the farmhouse has because you'll just sleep in the greenhouse or something anyway.
